May be applied to up to 3 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:

When Immolation Aura expires you explode, dealing all stored Ragefire damage to nearby enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 眼棱造成伤害结束后会使你进入恶魔形态，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Eye Beam causes you to enter demon form for 5 sec after it finishes dealing damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 献祭光环会在6秒内额外产生18点恶魔之怒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Immolation Aura generates an additional 18 Fury over 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blade Dance deals [(3 * (24.75% of Attack Power)% + (74.2% of Attack Power)%) * 195 / 100 * 1] Chaos damage to the first target struck.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 魔法伤害提高3%，受到的物理伤害降低5%。

Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. [Furious Gaze: When Eye Beam finishes fully channeling, your Haste is increased by an additional 8% for 8 sec]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 恶魔追击和复仇回避使你的伤害提高5%，持续20秒。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复仇回避的冷却时间缩短5秒，并在10秒内产生80点恶魔之怒。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you activate Metamorphosis, the cooldowns of Blade Dance and Eye Beam are immediately reset.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 完整施放眼棱之后，你的急速会额外提高8%，持续8秒。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Damaging an enemy before they damage you increases your critical strike chance by 10% for 5 sec.

Vengeful Retreat refreshes your potential to trigger this effect on any enemies you are in combat with.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 混乱打击返还20点恶魔之怒的几率提高，提高量等于你的爆击几率的30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The chance that Chaos Strike will refund 20 Fury is increased by 30% of your critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激活眼棱使你的下一个眼棱冷却时间减少2.5秒，最多减少10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Activating Eye Beam reduces the cooldown of your next Eye Beam by 2.5 sec, stacking up to 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 斩击你身前的所有敌人，造成([462% of Attack Power])点混沌伤害，使混乱打击和刃舞对其造成([257.4% of Attack Power])点混乱伤害，持续4秒。超过8个目标后伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Slash all enemies in front of you for (462% of Attack Power) Chaos damage, causing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance to deal (257.4% of Attack Power) Chaos damage to them for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的爆击伤害提高，数值等同于你的爆击几率的40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Gain critical strike damage equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

生命值低于50%时，吸血提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Damage is increased by 3% while above 50% Health.

Leech is increased by 5% while below 50% Health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你在刃舞期间偏转受到的攻击，最多吸收相当于最大生命值15%的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You deflect incoming attacks while Blade Dancing, absorbing damage up to 15% of your maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
疾影现在使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

此外，当你的生命值降至35%以下时，受到的伤害降低10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blur now reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.

Additionally, damage taken below 35% Health is reduced by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
受到的所有非火焰伤害的5%改为视作火焰伤害，持续6秒。

受到的火焰伤害降低10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.

Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
激活恶魔变形大幅强化眼棱、献祭光环。

恶魔形态激活时，之前每触发过一次魔涌，其造成的伤害提高5%。

 噬灭

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
Activating Metamorphosis greatly empowers Eye Beam, Immolation Aura.

Demonsurge damage is increased by 5% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.

 Devourer
Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.

Voidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.

 浩劫
恶魔之怒上限提高50点。

Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Maximum Fury increased by 50.

你的利刃燃烧着宇宙能量，使你的虚空之刃、饥渴斩击和投掷利刃造成额外35%的宇宙伤害。

收割的伤害提高20%。

 浩劫
你的利刃燃烧着邪能，使你的混乱打击、投掷利刃、刃舞的第一滴血和自动攻击在6秒内额外燃烧35%的火焰伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devourer
Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.

Reap damage increased by 20%.

 Havoc
Your blades burn with Fel energy, causing the damage from Chaos Strike, Throw Glaive, Blade Dance's First Blood, and auto-attacks to burn for an additional 35% damage as Fire over 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
不处于恶魔形态时，敏捷提高8%。

 噬灭
不处于恶魔形态时，智力提高15%。

坍缩之星的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
Agility increased by 8% while not in demon form.

 Devourer
Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.

Collapsing Star damage increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
当你激活恶魔变形时，重置献祭光环的冷却时间。

 噬灭
进入虚空变形时，重置虚空之刃和恶魔追击的冷却时间。

恶魔追击的伤害提高25%，并且会重置灵魂献祭的冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devourer
Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.

The Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.

 Havoc
When you activate Metamorphosis, reset the cooldown of Immolation Aura.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
混乱新星在其昏迷效果消失后，使敌人减速60%，并使其攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续5秒。 

 噬灭
虚空新星在其昏迷效果消失后，使敌人减速60%，并使其攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades. 

 Devourer
Void Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
在你脱离恶魔形态后，该形态仍以减弱状态持续，使你的混乱打击和刃舞伤害提高15%，急速提高5%。

 噬灭
在你脱离恶魔形态后，该形态仍以减弱状态持续，使你的精通：内在恶魔的效果提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance damage by 15%, and Haste by 5%.

 Devourer
The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
恶魔变形现在还会使恶魔之刃额外产生3点恶魔之怒。

恶魔形态激活时，你第一次施放每种强化技能时都会触发一次魔涌，使你爆发出邪能能量，对周围的敌人造成([280% of Attack Power])点混沌伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

 噬灭
虚空变形现在还会大幅强化虚空之刃和饥渴斩击。

恶魔形态激活时，你第一次施放每种强化技能时都会触发一次虚空涌动，使你爆发出虚空能量，对周围的敌人造成([625% of Spell Power])点宇宙伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
Metamorphosis now also causes Demon Blades to generate 3 additional Fury.

While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Demonsurge, causing you to explode with Fel energy, dealing (280% of Attack Power) Chaos damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

 Devourer
Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.

While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing (625% of Spell Power) Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
噬灭
当虚空涌动仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高50%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低10%。

 浩劫
当魔涌仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高50%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
Demonsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.

 Devourer
Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
献祭光环可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短6秒，并将造成的火焰伤害改为混沌伤害。

你可以同时激活多个献祭光环。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Immolation Aura has 1 additional charge, has 6 sec reduced cooldown, and deals Chaos damage instead of Fire.

You can have multiple Immolation Auras active at a time.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的混乱伤害有7.77%的几率提高17%，最多发生3次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 3 total times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 完全接纳体内深渊恶魔之火，恶魔变形期间获得全技能恶魔化大幅增伤并释放恶魔奔涌。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Embraces inner abyssal demonic fire, unleashing Demonic Surges and granting massive empowered forms during Metamorphosis.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
浩劫
献祭光环的半径提高2码，并且额外提高50%爆击伤害。

 噬灭
饥渴斩击的半径提高2码，并且额外提高125%爆击伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devourer
Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 125% increased critical strike damage bonus.

 Havoc
Immolation Aura has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 刃舞的最后一次斩击在击中3个或更多敌人时，消耗25点恶魔之怒，投出两把恶魔战刃，产生能量旋风，在3秒内对附近所有敌人造成[14 * ([13.2% of Attack Power])]点混乱伤害。目标数量超过8个后，造成的伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The final slash of Blade Dance consumes 25 Fury when it strikes 3 or more enemies, launching two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing [14 * (13.2% of Attack Power)] Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
噬灭
进入恶魔形态会使你的下一次虚空涌动在短暂延迟后重复。

 浩劫
进入恶魔形态会立即引发魔涌。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devourer
Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.

 Havoc
Entering demon form immediately induces a Demonsurge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
噬灭
宇宙伤害提高2%。

在恶魔形态下效果翻倍。

 浩劫
火焰伤害提高5%。

在恶魔形态下效果翻倍。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devourer
Cosmic damage increased by 2%.

Effect is doubled while in demon form.

 Havoc
Fire damage increased by 5%.

Effect is doubled while in demon form.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
噬灭
灵魂献祭有25%的几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。

 浩劫
献祭光环有25%的几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Havoc
Immolation Aura has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.

 Devourer
Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
刃舞伤害提高20%。

完全引导眼棱会使你的下一个刃舞刷新其自身的冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Blade Dance damage increased by 20%.

Fully channeling Eye Beam causes your next Blade Dance to refresh its own cooldown.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 恶魔追击的冷却时间减少15秒，造成的伤害提高15%，并且其持续伤害效果会额外施加给2个敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The Hunt has 15 sec reduced cooldown, deals 15% more damage, and its damage over time effect applies to 2 additional enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 恶魔追击强化你的下一个眼棱，使其伤害提高100%并影响更大区域的敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The Hunt empowers your next Eye Beam, increasing damage by 100% and affecting enemies in a wider area.
